newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti trading bands widened to 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti trading bands widened to 20 pct.

text.p: Italian stock market authorities widened fluctuation bands for trading in shares of troubled Olivetti for a second time on Monday to 20 percent from 15 after the stock twice failed to open on the bourse, dealers said.

Dealers said Olivetti shares were quoted at around 605/610 lire per share in pre-opening price fixing, compared with the stock's last reference price of 749 lire before it was suspended from trade on Thursday and Friday.
Earlier the stock market council widened the bands to 15 percent from the regular 10 percent after the share failed to open along with the rest of the bourse at the normal time.
Authorities have said the next opening is expected at 1202 local time (1002 GMT).
